study.question: Do explicit target-matched multiset counts and within-event category/brand conjunctions add useful information beyond a normalized history summary, at the same supplied-history boundary and small measured cost?
study.hypothesis: Source observation: baseline_reference.py softmax-normalizes event weights and sums category+brand+action+recency. Duplicating every valid event with identical age/type/IDs leaves the normalized summary unchanged while changing counts. This is an algebraic limitation, not observed evidence that counts predict labels. The attention scorer does contain implicit joint information, but no explicit same-event exact-match count is read out. Local evidence: baseline-din AUC 0.6133619861 exceeds pooled 0.6102261137 and static 0.6050036145. Four action-slot cells AUC 0.6119128872..0.6131550076 failed to improve it; field_values 0.6131854897 also lost to collapsed_values 0.6133112730, while collapsed_rms 0.6125376996 shows scale/optimization matter. In first-512 diagnostics field contrast energy was 0.7198, yet retaining it did not yield an overall win. New provisional hypothesis: expose a compact target-match count representation directly to the classifier, preserving multiplicity and field conjunction rather than allocating more embedding slots. Neither factor is presumed beneficial.

nearest_work.difference: DIN already motivates target-conditioned pooling and explicitly relaxes softmax normalization to retain interest intensity. We inherit the local activation reference but keep its softmax branch, adding four deterministic bucket-match statistics with factorial controls. This is not a new intensity principle or exact DIN reproduction; author implementation not audited here.

UniDot explicitly routes per-layer learned dot-product interactions to a classifier in a dual-bus system. Its tiny-mode component removal and source pCVR task do not establish transfer. Here fixed equality indicators are conjoined within each supplied event before counting, using a single shallow inherited model; no FM Highway, dot-product trainable path, bus fusion, delay head or optimizer transfer. Priority of this exact feature family is unverified; no global novelty claim.
Reference attention inputs, embedding sizes, query, recency encoding, hidden widths and normalized summary are preserved; four explicit match statistics extend the first classifier layer.

Prior intervention separated weighted field embedding summaries with a fixed shared scorer and nominal-capacity collapse controls. Current intervention reads unweighted event-level equality conjunctions and cardinality, not field-value slot directions. Prior negative and norm-control outcomes remain relevant counterevidence to simply expanding summaries.

inherited_components: Host supplied hashed static/history fields, causal construction, truncation and scoring contract
All baseline-din embedding tables, age bins, target category-plus-brand query, sum-of-fields event key/value and attention MLP with global masked softmax
Unweighted host loss, Adam/default training recipe, scratch initialization and host selection policy
study.proposed_difference: For each impression compute N=valid supplied events, C=valid events whose nonzero category ID equals the nonzero target category ID, B=analogous brand matches, and J=events satisfying both. Missing-to-missing never matches. Append four finite scalars to the existing static+attention-summary input. Factorial: fourth raw scalar is J or C*B/max(N,1); count encoding is log1p(raw)/log(129), rate encoding is [1(N>0),C/max(N,1),B/max(N,1),fourth/max(N,1)]. Four standalone modules share tensors and code paths. Empty and zero-width histories have zero summaries/statistics. Expected added dense weights=512 relative to baseline, all four cells equal; no additional embedding parameters. Complexity adds O(B*L) boolean/reduction work and four head inputs, not quadratic attention. Novelty is unverified; contribution sought is a controlled local information-granularity finding.
predictions: If target-field conjunction is consequential, joint_count should exceed independent_count and joint_rate exceed independent_rate in full validation AUC under paired seed42; one positive contrast alone is provisional and can be encoding interaction.

If multiplicity in supplied history is useful under this encoding, count-minus-rate AUC should have the same positive sign in both joint settings. Pure replication of all visible tuples changes count scalars and leaves rate scalars and normalized summary fixed, before the frozen cap intervenes.

Diagnostics should reveal nontrivial J versus C*B/N differences and nonzero joint-match support for the joint contrast to be informative. First-512 diagnostics are exploratory and may be unrepresentative.

Audit population slices already defined by host: baseline category_match_present has 2516922 samples/129821 positives/2387101 negatives, absent 717129/29616/687513; history_1_16 has 41805/1444/40361 and history_17_64 157391/6311/151080. Treat slice comparisons as exploratory, retain counts, and do not use tiny empty-history gains (8272/310/7962) as population mechanism confirmation.

All new cells have equal nominal parameter counts (expected 17130787 total, 52099 dense using baseline counts); wall time near 610-800 seconds is an estimate, not a measurement. Inspect host GPU/wall/memory/throughput/p50/p95 metrics before any efficiency claim.
falsifiers: No positive joint-minus-independent contrast in either encoding despite adequate joint/gap support weakens the usefulness of this explicit conjunction readout at the current recipe.
No positive count-minus-rate contrast in either setting weakens this count encoding, without refuting original DIN intensity or information preservation in general.
AUC gains disappearing across paired seeds, being restricted to small slices, or accompanied by material Logloss degradation do not establish a robust mechanism or model improvement.
Identical or near-identical J and C*B/N due to field nesting, absent joint matches, or near-constant cap counts render the relevant contrast weakly identified rather than a mechanism refutation.
Any ownership/information-boundary breach, nonfinite logits or incompatible sample identity invalidates the run; retain the failed receipt and charged costs.
alternative_explanations: Extra 512 classifier weights or changed first-layer initialization explain a baseline improvement; only within-suite comparisons are nominal-capacity matched.
Count/rate scaling, field nesting, hashed collisions, missingness and shorter-history activity proxies explain apparent effects.
Normalized embeddings and static features may already encode activity or co-occurrence; explicit statistics may only make optimization easier rather than recover otherwise absent information.
Host snapshots have undocumented as-of dates, and supplied histories truncate at128; findings are benchmark-scoped, not production causality.
Repeated validation-driven selection and one seed overstate gains; no unseen test outcome or independent confirmation is available.

contrasts.decision_if_supported: Require positive joint-minus-independent AUC in both encodings for an encoding-robust provisional conjunction finding. If only one encoding improves, treat as an interaction; repeat the complete factorial and inspect support diagnostics before claiming mechanism.
contrasts.decision_if_not_supported: Retain zero/negative cells. If J approximately equals C*B/N or joint matches are rare, mark contrast weakly identified; otherwise conclude this explicit joint readout was not useful under the current recipe, not that event conjunction is universally irrelevant.
